1.word_for_word: षट्-चत्वारिंशके घोषम् उद्धवं प्रेष्य तद्-गिरा । — In the sixth and fortieth century Ghoṣa sent Uddhava and spoke to him.; यशोदा-नन्दयोश् चक्रे कृष्णः शोकापनोदनम् ॥*॥ — Krishna relieved the sorrow of Yashoda and Nanda.; काम-चारं द्विजातिः सन् परित्यज्यातिसंयतः । — Being a brāhmaṇa he should abandon the practice of lust and be very self-controlled; गुरोर् ज्ञानम् अनुज्ञाप्य सख्या गोपीर् उपादिशत् ॥॥ — Having permitted the knowledge of his spiritual master he instructed his friend the gopīs; गोपीनां सान्त्वनम् अतिरहस्यं सन् मन्त्रि-साध्यम् इत्य् उद्धवं विशिनष्टि---वृष्णीनाम् इति । — He distinguishes Uddhava by saying that the consolation of the gopīs is very mysterious and can be achieved by a minister: that it is possible for the Vṛṣṇis.; बुद्धि-सत्तमः बुद्ध्यातिश्रेष्ठः ॥१॥ — The best of intellect is the best of intellect.
1.translation: In the sixth and fortieth century Ghoṣa sent Uddhava and spoke to him. Krishna relieved the sorrow of Yashoda and Nanda. Being a brāhmaṇa he should abandon the practice of lust and be very self-controlled Having permitted the knowledge of his spiritual master he instructed his friend the gopīs He distinguishes Uddhava by saying that the consolation of the gopīs is very mysterious and can be achieved by a minister: that it is possible for the Vṛṣṇis. The best of intellect is the best of intellect.

4.word_for_word: गोपीनां विशेषतः सन्देशे कारणम् आह---ता इति । — He argues that the reason for the gopis, especially in the message, is that they are.; मय्य् एव सङ्कल्पात्मकं मनो यासां ताः । — Those whose minds are fixed on Me alone; अहम् एव प्राणो यासां ताः । — Those whose life I am.; मद्-अर्थे त्यक्ता दैहिकाः पति-पुत्रादयो याभिस् ताः । — Those who have given up their bodies, such as their husbands and children, for My sake.; ततः किं ? — What's next?; अत आह---ये त्यक्त-लोक-धर्मा इति । — Therefore he argues that those who have abandoned the dharmas of the world.; मन्-निमित्तं त्यक्तौ लोक-धर्माव् इहामुत्र सुखे तत्-साधनानि च यैः, तान् बिभर्मि पोषयामि संवर्धयामि सुखयामीत्य् अर्थः ॥४॥ — Those who have given up for My sake the duties of this world and the means of attaining happiness in this world and the next, I sustain them, nourish them, nourish them and make them happy, that is, I make them happy.
4.translation: He argues that the reason for the gopis, especially in the message, is that they are. Those whose minds are fixed on Me alone Those whose life I am. Those who have given up their bodies, such as their husbands and children, for My sake. What's next? Therefore he argues that those who have abandoned the dharmas of the world. Those who have given up for My sake the duties of this world and the means of attaining happiness in this world and the next, I sustain them, nourish them, nourish them and make them happy, that is, I make them happy.

5.word_for_word: तासां वियोगाधिं दर्शयति द्वयेन--मयि ता इति । — He shows the pain of their separation in two ways: they are in me.; विरहेण यत औत्कण्ठ्यं, तेन विह्वलाः परवशाः ॥५॥ — They are overwhelmed by the anxiety caused by separation and are subdued by others.
5.translation: He shows the pain of their separation in two ways: they are in me. They are overwhelmed by the anxiety caused by separation and are subdued by others.

6.word_for_word: गोकुलात् निर्गमन-समये शीघ्रम् आगमिष्यामीति ये प्रत्यागमन-सन्देशाः, तैर् मे मदीया बल्लव्यो गोप्यो मद्-आत्मिका इति तासाम् आत्मा स्व-देहे यदि स्यात्, तदा विरह-तापेन दह्येतैव । — If the souls of My beloved gopīs, who are My souls, are in their own bodies, they will be burnt by the heat of separation.; मयि वर्तमानत्वात् कथञ्चित् जीवन्तीति भावः ॥६॥ — This means that they somehow live because they are present in Me.
6.translation: If the souls of My beloved gopīs, who are My souls, are in their own bodies, they will be burnt by the heat of separation. This means that they somehow live because they are present in Me.

7.word_for_word: सन्देशं भवतीनां वियोगो मे नहि सर्वात्मना क्वचिद् इत्य्-आदिकम् ॥७॥ — The message to you is that separation from me is never with all my soul, etc.
7.translation: The message to you is that separation from me is never with all my soul, etc.

8.word_for_word: निम्लोचति अस्तं गच्छति सति । — It looks down as it sets.; छन्नं यानं यस्य स इति तदा गोपीभिर् अज्ञातत्वेन नन्द-सङ्गं लब्धवान् इति सूचयति ॥८॥ — He whose chariot was hidden indicates that he had attained the association of Nanda unknown to the gopīs.
8.translation: It looks down as it sets. He whose chariot was hidden indicates that he had attained the association of Nanda unknown to the gopīs.

9.word_for_word: व्रजं वर्णयति पञ्चभिः---वासितार्थ इत्य्-आदिना । — He describes Vraja in five ways: the purpose of smelling.; वासिताः पुष्पवत्यो गावस् तन्-निमित्तम् अभितो युध्यद्भिः शुष्मिभिर् मत्तैर् वृषैर् नादितम्। — The cows were fragrant with their flowers and the drunken bulls of Shushmi were fighting all around; वास्राभिर् धेनुभिः । — with clothes and cows.; स्व-वत्सकान् प्रति ॥९॥ — towards their own calves.
9.translation: He describes Vraja in five ways: the purpose of smelling. The cows were fragrant with their flowers and the drunken bulls of Shushmi were fighting all around with clothes and cows. towards their own calves.

10.word_for_word: विलङ्घद्भिः उत्पतद्भिः गो-दोह-शब्दैः सहाभितो रवाः मुञ्च, मा मुञ्च, नय, आनय, देहि, गृहाणेत्य्-आदयो यस्मिंस् तम् । — The sounds of cow-milking, which were jumping and jumping, were surrounded by the sounds of let go, don’t let go, take, bring, give, take, and so on.; वेणूनां निःस्वनेन च मण्डितम् ॥१०॥ — It was adorned with the sound of flutes
10.translation: The sounds of cow-milking, which were jumping and jumping, were surrounded by the sounds of let go, don’t let go, take, bring, give, take, and so on. It was adorned with the sound of flutes

11.word_for_word: गायन्तीभिर् गोपीभिर् गोपैश् च सुविराजितम् ॥११॥ — It was well illuminated by the singing gopis and the cowherd men
11.translation: It was well illuminated by the singing gopis and the cowherd men

12.word_for_word: अग्न्य्-आद्य्-अर्चनान्वितैर् गोप-गृहैर् धूपादिभिश् च मनोरमम् ॥१२॥ — It was delightful with the houses of the cowherd men and with the worship of fire and other objects and with incense and other objects.
12.translation: It was delightful with the houses of the cowherd men and with the worship of fire and other objects and with incense and other objects.

13.word_for_word: षण्डः समूहः ॥१३॥ — The sixth is the group.

14.word_for_word: आर्चयत् पूजयामास ॥१४॥ — He worshiped and worshipped.

15.word_for_word: कशिपौ शय्यायां संविष्टम् ॥१५॥ — Kashipu was lying on the bed.
15.translation: Kashipu was lying on the bed.

17.word_for_word: दिष्ट्या इति कर्मणि षष्ठी, हिंसार्थानां प्रयोगे ॥१७॥ — fortunately, the sixth in the action, in the use of the meanings of violence.
17.translation: fortunately, the sixth in the action, in the use of the meanings of violence.

18.word_for_word: गावो गाः । — Cows are cows.; गिरिं गोवर्धनम् ॥१८॥ — The mountain Govardhana.
18.translation: Cows are cows. The mountain Govardhana.

19.word_for_word: अप्य् आयास्यत्य् आगमिष्यति किम् ॥१९॥ — Will he come and what will he come?
19.translation: Will he come and what will he come?

20.word_for_word: श्री-कृष्णोपकार-स्मरणादिभिर् अनुपमानन्देनाभिभूयमान आह---दावाग्नेर् इत्य्-आदिना । — Overwhelmed with incomparable joy by remembering the benevolence of Lord Kṛṣṇa, he said; वाताद् वर्षाच् चेति वृषात् सर्पाच् चेति अन्येभ्यश् च दुरतिक्रमेभ्यो मृत्युभ्यः श्री-कृष्णेन रक्षिताः स्मः ॥२०॥ — We have been protected by Lord Kṛṣṇa from wind, rain, bull, snake and other insurmountable deaths.
20.translation: Overwhelmed with incomparable joy by remembering the benevolence of Lord Kṛṣṇa, he said We have been protected by Lord Kṛṣṇa from wind, rain, bull, snake and other insurmountable deaths.

21.word_for_word: किं च, स्मरताम् इति । — What’s more, let’s remember.; लीलयापाङ्गेन निरीक्षितम् । — It was observed with a playful eye.; अङ्ग हे उद्धव ॥२१॥ — Anga, O Uddhava!
21.translation: What’s more, let’s remember. It was observed with a playful eye. Anga, O Uddhava!

22.word_for_word: न केवलं शिथिला एव किन्तु शनैर् उपरमन्तीत्य् आह सरिद् इत्य्-आदि । — Not only are they loose, but they slowly subside, he says, and so on.; सरितश् च वनोद्देशाश् च तान् आक्रीडान् क्रीडा-स्थानानि ॥२१ ॥ — The rivers and forest areas are the places where these games are played.
22.translation: Not only are they loose, but they slowly subside, he says, and so on. The rivers and forest areas are the places where these games are played.

23.word_for_word: सुराणाम् अर्थाय महत् गम्भीरं, गर्गस्य वचनं यथा ॥२३॥ — It is great and profound for the sake of the devatas, as the words of Garga.
23.translation: It is great and profound for the sake of the devatas, as the words of Garga.

24.word_for_word: न केवलं तद्-वचोऽनुसारेणैव व्यवहार-संवादाद् अपीत्य् आह कंसम् इति ॥२३ ॥ — He argued that Kaṁsa was not only in accordance with the words of the Supreme Personality of Godhead but also in conversation with Him.
24.translation: He argued that Kaṁsa was not only in accordance with the words of the Supreme Personality of Godhead but also in conversation with Him.

25.word_for_word: इभ-राट् यष्टिम् इव ताल-त्रय-प्रमाणं धनुर् बभञ्ज ॥२५॥ — The king of elephants broke his bow the size of three palms like a stick
25.translation: The king of elephants broke his bow the size of three palms like a stick

31.word_for_word: अखिल-गुरुत्वम् एव जनकत्वेन नियन्तृत्वेन चाह---एताव् इति । — He argues that the whole gravity is the cause and the controller.; रामो मुकुन्दश् चेत्य् एतौ विश्वस्य बीज-योनी निमित्तोपादाने । — Rāma and Mukunda are the seeds and sources of the universe, and they are the sources of the universe.; ननु पुरुष-प्रधानयोर् बीज-योनित्वं प्रसिद्धम् ? — Is it true that the seed-vagina of the male-dominated is well known?; अत आह---पुरुषः प्रधानम् इति । — Therefore, he argues that the man is the principal.; पुरुषोऽंशः । — The male part.; प्रधानं शक्तिः । — The principal is power.; अतः प्रधान-पुरुषाव् अप्य् एताव् एवेत्य् अर्थः । — Therefore, it means that the principal persons are also the same.; एवं जनकत्वम् उक्तम् । — Thus the parenthood is said.; किं च, अन्वीय भूतेषु भूतेष्व् अनुप्रविश्य भूतानां तद् उपहितस्य विलक्षणस्य नाना-भेदस्य ज्ञानस्य जीवस्य चेशाते ईश्वरौ नियन्तारौ भवतः । — Moreover, the Supreme Personality of Godhead is the controller of the living entity, who enters into all living entities by searching for them.; कुतः ? — Where is it from?; पुराणाव् अनादी । — Puranav eternal.; अनादित्वात् कारणत्वं ततश् च नियन्तृत्वम् इत्य् अर्थः ॥३१॥ — Being eternal, it means that it is the cause and therefore the controller.
31.translation: He argues that the whole gravity is the cause and the controller. Rāma and Mukunda are the seeds and sources of the universe, and they are the sources of the universe. Is it true that the seed-vagina of the male-dominated is well known? Therefore, he argues that the man is the principal. The male part. The principal is power. Therefore, it means that the principal persons are also the same. Thus the parenthood is said. Moreover, the Supreme Personality of Godhead is the controller of the living entity, who enters into all living entities by searching for them. Where is it from? Puranav eternal. Being eternal, it means that it is the cause and therefore the controller.

32.word_for_word: ननु सृष्ट्य्-आदि-कर्मावेशान् मनुष्यादि-जन्म-दर्श्नाच् च तस्यान्येभ्यः को विशेष इत्य् आशङ्क्याह---यस्मिन्न् इति द्वाभ्याम् । — If, indeed, he sees the creation and other actions and the birth of man and others, what is the difference between him and the others?; कर्माशयं कर्म-वासनां निर्हृत्य त्यक्त्वा ब्रह्म-मयः स्वरूप-ज्ञानवान् अर्क-वर्णः शुद्ध-सत्त्व-मूर्तिः सन् पराः गतिं तत् पदं याति ॥३२॥ — Having dispelled the desire for action and having abandoned the desire for action, he who is full of the Absolute Truth, who has knowledge of his nature, whose complexion is like the sun and who is the embodiment of pure Sattva, attains to that supreme destination.
32.translation: If, indeed, he sees the creation and other actions and the birth of man and others, what is the difference between him and the others? Having dispelled the desire for action and having abandoned the desire for action, he who is full of the Absolute Truth, who has knowledge of his nature, whose complexion is like the sun and who is the embodiment of pure Sattva, attains to that supreme destination.

33.word_for_word: अखिलस्यात्मा च हेतुश् च तस्मिन् कारणेन मनुष्याकृतौ महात्मन् महात्मनि परिपूर्णे भवन्तौ भक्तिं कुरुतः । — You are the soul and the cause of the entire universe, and for that reason you are the greatest of all human beings, and you are the greatest of all, and you are engaged in devotional service.; अतः कृत-कृत-कृत्याव् इत्य् अर्थः ॥३३॥ — Therefore, it means that they have done and done.
33.translation: You are the soul and the cause of the entire universe, and for that reason you are the greatest of all human beings, and you are the greatest of all, and you are engaged in devotional service. Therefore, it means that they have done and done.

34.word_for_word: प्रस्तुतम् आह---आगमिष्यति इति । — The presenter argues that it will come.; पित्रोर् युवयोः ॥३४॥ — of the fathers and you.
34.translation: The presenter argues that it will come. of the fathers and you.

35.word_for_word:
> यात यूयं व्रजं तात वयं च स्नेह-दुःखितान् । — > Go to Vraja, my dear, and we will be affectionately grieved.; >
> ज्ञातीन् वो द्रष्टुम् एष्यामो विधाय सुहृदां सुखम् ॥ — >
> We will come to see your relatives and friends and make you happy.; [भा।पु। — [Bh.P.; > १०.४५.१३] — > 10.45.13]; इति यद् आह कृष्णस् तत् सत्यं करिष्यातीति ॥३५॥ — Thus whatever Krishna said will come true.
35.translation:
> Go to Vraja, my dear, and we will be affectionately grieved. >
> We will come to see your relatives and friends and make you happy. [Bh.P. > 10.45.13] Thus whatever Krishna said will come true.

36.word_for_word: काल-विलम्बनम् असहमानौ प्रत्याह---मा खिद्यतम् इति । — Unable to tolerate the delay, they replied, "Don't worry.; हे महा-भागौ ! — O great-fortunates!; अन्तिके इदानीम् एव समीपे वा । — Nearby or right now.; कुतः ? — Where is it from?; इत्य् अत आह---अन्तर्-हृदीति । — It is therefore argued that it is the inner heart.; तर्हि सर्वैः किम् इति न दृश्यते ? — So why doesn't everyone see it?; तत्राह---ज्योतिर् इवैधसीति । — There he says, "You are like light.; तद् यथा मथनं विना न दृश्यते, तथा भक्तिं विना कृष्णोऽपीति भावः ॥३६॥ — That is, just as it cannot be seen without churning, so also Krishna cannot be seen without devotion.
36.translation: Unable to tolerate the delay, they replied, "Don't worry. O great-fortunates! Nearby or right now. Where is it from? It is therefore argued that it is the inner heart. So why doesn't everyone see it? There he says, "You are like light. That is, just as it cannot be seen without churning, so also Krishna cannot be seen without devotion.

37-39.word_for_word: अहो आस्ताम् एतत् तस्य त्व् इहागमनं स्वस्याति-प्रियान् पित्रादीन् विहाय न सङ्गच्छत इति मन्येत, तत्राह---न ह्य् अस्येति । — Oh, let it be that he thinks that his coming here does not coincide with leaving his very dear father and others behind.; अस्य प्रियादयो न हि सन्ति । — He doesn’t have anything like his beloved.; तत्र हेतू---अमानिनः समानस्येति च । — The reason for this is that they are dishonest and of the same.; सोऽपि जन्म-कर्मादि-रहितोऽपि क्रीडा-प्रयोजनः सन् स साधूनां परिपालनाय सद्-असन्-मिश्र-योनिषु सात्त्विक-राजस-तामस-योनिषु, यद्वा देवादि-मत्स्यादि-नृसिंहादि-योनिषु कल्पते आविर्भवतीत्य् अर्थः ॥३७-३९॥ — This means that even though He is devoid of birth, action and other activities and has the purpose of play, He appears in the mixed worlds of good and evil, in the worlds of Sattva, Rajas and Tamas, or in the worlds of devas, fish, Nṛsiṁha and others, for the protection of the saintly persons.
37-39.translation: Oh, let it be that he thinks that his coming here does not coincide with leaving his very dear father and others behind. He doesn’t have anything like his beloved. The reason for this is that they are dishonest and of the same. This means that even though He is devoid of birth, action and other activities and has the purpose of play, He appears in the mixed worlds of good and evil, in the worlds of Sattva, Rajas and Tamas, or in the worlds of devas, fish, Nṛsiṁha and others, for the protection of the saintly persons.

40.word_for_word: ननु जन्म-कर्मादि-रहितस्य कुत एतद् इत्य् अत आह---सत्त्वम् इति । — If so, where is this from the one without birth, action, etc.?; कीडाम् अतीतोऽपि क्रीडन् । — Playing past the worm.; तथापि माया-गुणैर् घटत इत्य् अर्थः ॥४०॥ — Yet it happens by the modes of illusion, this means.
40.translation: If so, where is this from the one without birth, action, etc.? Playing past the worm. Yet it happens by the modes of illusion, this means.

41.word_for_word: अत्राविद्योपाधेर् जीवस्य कर्तृत्वं दृष्टान्ती-कुर्वंस् तस्याविद्ययैव कर्तृत्वम् इति स-दृष्टान्तम् आह---यथेति । — Here, illustrating the doership of the living entity under the pretext of ignorance, he argues that ignorance is the doership of the living entity.; भ्रमरिका परिभ्रमणं तयोपलक्षितया दृष्ट्या भूर् अपि भ्राम्यतीति यथा प्रतीयते, एवं चित्ते कर्तरि सति तत्र चित्तेऽहं-धिया आत्माध्यासेनात्मा कर्ता स्मृतो यथा, तद्वद् इति ॥४१॥ — Just as the rotation of the whirlwind is perceived by the sight of the earth as revolving, so when the mind is in the doer, the ego-consciousness, by meditating on the Self, remembers the Self as the doer, and so it is.
41.translation: Here, illustrating the doership of the living entity under the pretext of ignorance, he argues that ignorance is the doership of the living entity. Just as the rotation of the whirlwind is perceived by the sight of the earth as revolving, so when the mind is in the doer, the ego-consciousness, by meditating on the Self, remembers the Self as the doer, and so it is.

42.word_for_word: किं च, युवयोर् एव नायम् आत्मजः, किन्तु सर्वेषाम् अपि । — What’s more, it’s not just you two who have a son, but everyone else.; तत्रापि नात्मज एव, किन्तु शत्रु-मित्रादि-रूपोऽपीति सर्वात्मत्व-निरूपणेन मोह-निवृत्तये सम्बन्धम् अनैकान्तिकी-करोति---युवयोर् एवेति द्वाभ्याम् ॥४२॥ — Even there, by describing Him as the omnipresent Self, not only His son, but also in the form of enemies, friends and others, He makes the relationship non-exclusive for the purpose of relieving delusion—that He is the same as both of you.
42.translation: What’s more, it’s not just you two who have a son, but everyone else. Even there, by describing Him as the omnipresent Self, not only His son, but also in the form of enemies, friends and others, He makes the relationship non-exclusive for the purpose of relieving delusion—that He is the same as both of you.

43.word_for_word: अच्युताद् विना तरां नितरां तत्त्वतो वाच्यं निर्वचनार्हं वस्तु नास्तीति ॥४३॥ — It is truly to be said that there is nothing worthy of being described beyond the infallible Supreme Being.
43.translation: It is truly to be said that there is nothing worthy of being described beyond the infallible Supreme Being.

44.word_for_word: दीपान् निरूप्य प्रज्वाल्य । — Determine the lamps and light them.; वास्तून् देहल्य्-आदीन् ॥४४॥ — buildings such as Delhi.
44.translation: Determine the lamps and light them. buildings such as Delhi.

45.word_for_word: मणिभिः काञ्च्य्-आदिषु स्थितैः रज्जूर् विकर्षत्सु भुजेषु कङ्कणानां स्रजो यासां ताः । — They wore garlands of bracelets on their arms, which were pulled by strings of gems, such as gold and silver.; चलन्तो नितम्बाः स्तना हाराश् च यासां ताः, कुण्डलैस् त्विषन्तः स्फुरन्तः कपोला यासां ताः, अरुणानि कुङ्कुमानि येषु तान्य् आननानि यासां ता एव ताश् च ताश् च ॥४५॥ — Those whose hips and breasts were moving, whose foreheads were glittering with earrings, whose faces were covered with red saffron, they were the same and they were the same.
45.translation: They wore garlands of bracelets on their arms, which were pulled by strings of gems, such as gold and silver. Those whose hips and breasts were moving, whose foreheads were glittering with earrings, whose faces were covered with red saffron, they were the same and they were the same.

47.word_for_word: तदा व्रजौकसो गोप्यः ॥४७॥ — Then the cowherd women of Vraja.
47.translation: Then the cowherd women of Vraja.

48.word_for_word: स-क्रोधम् आहुः---अक्रूर इति । — They call that anger Akrura.; अर्थं साधितवान् इत्य् अर्थ-साधकः । — The meaning-seeker is the one who has achieved the meaning.; तद् आहुः---येन नीत इति ॥४८॥ — That is what they say, by whom he was brought.
48.translation: They call that anger Akrura. The meaning-seeker is the one who has achieved the meaning. That is what they say, by whom he was brought.

49.word_for_word: कंसं घातयित्वा पुनः किम् अर्थम् आगत इत्य् आशङ्क्य स्वयम् एव कारणं सम्भावयन्ति, किम् इति । — They wonder what it means to have killed Kaṁsa and come back. They assume the reason for themselves.; तदा साधितेन कार्येण प्रीतस्य तुष्टस्य भर्तुः । — Then her husband was pleased and satisfied with the work he had accomplished.; पाठान्तरे प्रेतस्य मृतस्य कंसस्य निष्कृतिम् और्ध्व-देहिकम् अस्माभिः कृत्वा साधयिष्यते किम् । — In another text, can we accomplish the expiation of the dead Kaṁsa by performing the upper body?; अस्मन् मांसैः पिण्डान् कृत्वा दास्यतीत्य् अर्थः । — This means that he will make lumps of meat and give it to us.; इत्य् एवं वदन्तीनां स्त्रीणां ततस् तस्मिन्न् अवसरे कृताह्निकः कृत-स्नानादि-नियम उद्धव आगत इति ॥४९॥ — While the women were thus speaking Uddhava arrived on that occasion having performed the rituals of bathing and other rituals
49.translation: They wonder what it means to have killed Kaṁsa and come back. They assume the reason for themselves. Then her husband was pleased and satisfied with the work he had accomplished. In another text, can we accomplish the expiation of the dead Kaṁsa by performing the upper body? This means that he will make lumps of meat and give it to us. While the women were thus speaking Uddhava arrived on that occasion having performed the rituals of bathing and other rituals
